author: 林爱丽
character_lock: 剑刺 / Jian Ci: tall pale adult Chinese forensic doctor, short black side-part hair, white forensic coat over black high-neck shirt, black gloves, never glasses, restrained low male Mandarin voice. 林浅 / Lin Qian: adult Chinese investigator, chin-length black bob, navy uniform, black gloves, steady mid-low female Mandarin voice. 周峤 / Zhou Qiao: adult Chinese digital-forensics expert, silver-rim glasses and hearing device, charcoal technical jacket, measured male Mandarin voice. 许未 / Xu Wei: adult Chinese forensic analyst, brown high ponytail, olive forensic coverall, black gloves, clear female Mandarin voice. 李凯 / Li Kai: ordinary adult Chinese male, short black hair, charcoal-gray hoodie under dark tech jacket, no glasses, anxious but not villainous. 江岚 / Jiang Lan: adult Chinese woman with shoulder-length black hair and dark gray top; show respectfully only in pre-recorded screen images or tactful covered-scene context.
global_negative: No face swap, no duplicate person, no wardrobe drift, no extra crowd, no distorted hands, no readable text, no subtitles, no title card, no watermark, no visible interface, no real footage, no photorealism, no 3D, no chibi, no gore, no blood, no fangs, no red eyes, no supernatural proof, no static concept poster.

clips.scene: Direct match-cut from S01E08: the same wet blue-black metal desk, black laptop and tiny red live-status dot; Jiang Lan remains blurred and still on the screen. Lin Qian protects the evidence without interrupting the feed.
shots: Same E08 laptop and red live dot, Jiang Lan blurred on screen
Macro of the dot reflected in wet steel
Lin Qian enters in profile, alert and calm
Her gloved hand places an evidence tent beside the keyboard

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.zh: 凌晨零点十七分，江岚的直播还在继续。
dialogue.en: At 12:17 a.m., Jiang Lan's livestream is still running.

clips.scene: Jiang Lan's apartment studio is cold and intact. Lin Qian photographs and bags devices methodically while Zhou Qiao monitors the still-live stream from a separate station.
shots: High overhead of sealed livestream desk
Lin photographs the webcam without touching it
She bags a phone while the red light remains
Zhou receives a sealed cable at the monitor

dialogue.speaker: 林浅
dialogue.zh: 设备全部封存，先别断网。
dialogue.en: Seal every device. Do not cut the network yet.

clips.scene: Digital-forensics lab. Zhou Qiao compares repeated presenter gestures and audio peaks, while Lin Qian sees the artificial repetition for the first time.
shots: Zhou in profile, glasses and hearing device clear
Abstract repeated presenter gestures and red dot on monitor
Gloved finger aligns waveform peaks
Lin sees the repeated motion over Zhou's shoulder

dialogue.speaker: 周峤
dialogue.en: Those comment replies are not live.

clips.scene: Tactful mortuary examination. Jiang Lan is fully covered; Jian Ci uses ordinary temperature and postmortem observations, while the live red dot persists only in the distant background.
shots: Jian opens a stainless examination case by the covered gurney
Close clinical temperature check at the covered wrist
Jian studies clock and condensation while Lin waits
Jian turns calmly toward Lin, laptop dot far behind

dialogue.speaker: 剑刺
dialogue.zh: 死亡时间早于这场直播。

clips.scene: Zhou identifies a pre-recorded broadcast branch built the previous day. Devices remain isolated and no data screen is readable.
shots: Zhou studies a branch-network monitor
One abstract source splits into two blue paths
He compares two sealed drives
Lin and Zhou understand the branch without celebration

dialogue.speaker: 周峤
dialogue.zh: 昨天就建好了预录分支。
dialogue.en: The prerecorded branch was created yesterday.

clips.scene: A chipped black tablet is separately isolated. Zhou traces its connection as a trigger source; Li Kai arrives, but the team makes no accusation.
shots: Lin's gloves place the chipped tablet on an evidence table
Zhou traces an abstract device-source line
Lin receives a notification in profile
Li Kai waits at interview-room glass; tablet remains sealed foreground

dialogue.speaker: 周峤
dialogue.zh: 触发它的，是李凯的平板。

clips.scene: Interview room. Lin Qian questions Li Kai with the tablet kept sealed between them. Jian Ci observes through glass; no supernatural reaction and no premature blame.
shots: Wide through observation glass: Lin faces Li Kai
Lin sets the sealed tablet bag on the table
Li Kai's empty hands and uneasy face
Jian Ci observes silently through one-way glass

dialogue.speaker: 林浅
dialogue.zh: 李凯，你为什么碰过她的平板？
dialogue.en: Li Kai, why did you touch her tablet?

clips.scene: Lin presents a revenue-share lead with a folder and an abstract split-reflection graphic. It is motive only, not a conclusion.
shots: Lin reads a folder at evidence wall
Abstract split coin-like reflection, no words
Li Kai processes the implication behind glass
Lin sets the folder beside untouched sealed tablet

dialogue.speaker: 林浅
dialogue.zh: 她死后，你会多拿一半分成。
dialogue.en: After she died, your share would double.

clips.scene: Forensic chemistry lab. Xu Wei keeps an unmarked, sealed personal spray item separate from a blood sample, then reports a sedative metabolite finding. Never state a dose, recipe, or method; toxicology explains a mechanism, not an identity.
shots: Xu prepares a sealed blood vial
Autosampler receives one vial while an unmarked sealed spray item stays on a separate tray
Abstract spectral peak on blank dark monitor
Xu hands sealed toxicology envelope to Jian

dialogue.speaker: 许未
dialogue.zh: 质谱检出镇静药代谢物；毒理不负责认人。
dialogue.en: Mass spectrometry found sedative metabolites; toxicology does not identify the person.

clips.scene: Fingerprint work, backend trace and toxicology occupy separate evidence stations, then form one cautious visual chain without mixing the evidence.
shots: Lin dusts tablet edge for prints
Zhou follows abstract backend trace
Xu places a sealed vial on separate tray
Overhead: three evidence islands linked only by thin lines

dialogue.speaker: 林浅
dialogue.zh: 每一项都不够；合起来才够。
dialogue.en: No single piece is enough. Together, they are.

clips.scene: Respectful lab/morgue. Jiang Lan remains covered. Jian Ci explains the evidentiary distinction to Lin with the ongoing red dot in the distance.
shots: Covered gurney and Jian at evidence bench
Jian speaks calmly to Lin
Small red live dot reflected behind his white coat
Lin considers three separate evidence trays

dialogue.speaker: 剑刺
dialogue.zh: 直播没结束，不等于江岚还活着。
dialogue.en: A livestream still running does not mean Jiang Lan is alive.

clips.scene: An automated original file completes sending. The red live dot fades out. A sealed unmarked drive with a faint blue indicator remains as the bridge to the next episode.
shots: Dark laptop, red dot dims
Lin holds sealed storage drive
Jian and Lin see the stream go dark
Final close: black drive on metal desk, faint blue light toward corridor

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.zh: 预设文件发出后，直播终于熄灭。
dialogue.en: When the scheduled file was sent, the stream finally went dark.
